items.label: Capture the Lean Dispatch operating context.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, Evidence target, risks, and unknowns are identified before editing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > agent-and-skill-design, owner repo-project-control, active role project-control-steward with planning-partner and documentation-authority-steward responsibilities, phase target phase-agent-and-skill-design-lean-dispatch-operating-rules, checklist target checklist-agent-and-skill-design-lean-dispatch-operating-rules, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules-2026-09-02.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard for Lean Dispatch.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Project Control test fails before the Lean Dispatch document, records, and entrypoint references exist.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because doc-flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules was not linked from the project-control node and Project Control entrypoints did not reference docs/domains/flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules.md.

items.label: Define Resource Budget fields.
items.evidenceTarget: The Lean Dispatch rules define contextBudget, verificationTier, reviewTier, evidenceMode, handoffDetail, and docReadPolicy.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules.md defines Resource Budget fields that must be visible in the Room Run Registry or dispatch notes before a lane runs in lean mode.

items.label: Define the Lean Kickoff Packet.
items.evidenceTarget: The Lean Kickoff Packet keeps lane scope, Return Channel, Active Return Command, handoff ID, liveness, retrievable locator, Resource Budget, stop condition, and Compact Terminal Handoff requirements.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules.md defines the Lean Kickoff Packet and explicitly prevents lean mode from removing return path, liveness, owner repository, accepted scope, or evidence target.

items.label: Define Reference Pack and escalation triggers.
items.evidenceTarget: The rules define source document pointers, triggered full reads, and conditions that expand a lean lane.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules.md defines the Reference Pack and escalation triggers for missing acknowledgement, missing return/locator fields, Contract Change Requests, public API, secrets, storage, renderer, PDF bytes, UX artifacts treated as evidence, and map-truth claims.

items.label: Define verification and evidence tiers.
items.evidenceTarget: The rules define read-only, focused, standard, and full verification tiers plus registry-note, batched-evidence, and full-acceptance-record evidence modes.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules.md keeps low-cost verification for no-edit probes while requiring exact commit evidence and fresh owner-repository verification for accepted changed product behavior.

items.label: Route Lean Dispatch from PLAN and Work Type documents.
items.evidenceTarget: Agent onboarding, agent operating model, delivery model, PLAN Room Orchestration Rules, Work Type Routing Model, and first delivery round plan reference Lean Dispatch.

items.label: Verify the focused guard and Project Control gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Lean Dispatch guard, generation, data validation, and full Project Control gate pass before handoff.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: tests/flowdoc-lean-dispatch-operating-rules.test.ts, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check pass after Project Control records are registered.
